description: This file contains an implementation of the Unicode Bidi Parentheses Algorithm, including bracket pairing, classification, and resolution logic, used for bidirectional text processing.

classes.name: bracketType
classes.description: Enumeration for bracket types: None, Open, Close.

classes.name: bracketPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of indices for matching brackets.

classes.name: bracketPairs
classes.description: Slice of bracketPair with sorting capabilities.

classes.name: bracketPairer
classes.description: Handles locating and resolving bracket pairs within a sequence.

methods.name: matchOpener
methods.description: Checks if two positions form a matching bracket pair.

methods.name: locateBrackets
methods.description: Finds matching bracket pairs according to Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm BD16.

methods.name: getStrongTypeN0
methods.description: Maps character's directional code to a strong type for rule N0.

methods.name: classifyPairContent
methods.description: Determines the strong types within a bracket pair assuming a given embedding direction.

methods.name: classBeforePair
methods.description: Finds the strong type before a bracket pair.

methods.name: assignBracketType
methods.description: Implements rule N0 for a single bracket pair, assigning directional types.

methods.name: setBracketsToType
methods.description: Sets the directional type for a bracket pair and surrounding non-spacing marks.

methods.name: resolveBrackets
methods.description: Processes all bracket pairs in a sequence to assign types based on content.
